documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Nordvik Capital (fictional, authored test material).
Employees at Nordvik Capital stood at 1022 in FY2025, as restated in the latest accounts. Nordvik Capital had net revenue retention of 112.6% in FY2025, first issue. For Nordvik Capital, capex as share of sales in FY2024 was 3.9%. Order backlog at Nordvik Capital stood at €553.9m with effect from 1 Jul 2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Management presentation
documents.text:
Management presentation: Nordvik Capital (fictional, authored test material).
Run-rate EBITDA at Nordvik Capital stood at €62.5m in FY2024 (reported basis). Nordvik GmbH had headline purchase price of €850.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Nordvik Capital, capex as share of sales in FY2024 was around 3.8%. Order backlog at Nordvik Capital stood at €501.9m with effect from 1 Jan 2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Buyer quality-of-earnings memo
documents.text:
Buyer quality-of-earnings memo: Nordvik Capital (fictional, authored test material).
Employees at Nordvik Capital stood at 1265 in FY2025, as originally reported. Nordvik Capital had net revenue retention of 134.2% in FY2025, second issue (corrects the first issue). For Nordvik Nordic, a subsidiary, run-rate EBITDA in FY2024 was €68.8m (reported basis). Headline purchase price at Nordvik Oy stood at €1056.1m in FY2025 (reported basis).
